title: ever ISLA|Deep V-Neck Mesh Batwing Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This V-neck mesh formal dress brings together elegance and comfort. The batwing sleeves drape softly to flatter the arms, while the pleated skirt and high waistband create a graceful, slimming shape. Ideal for weddings, evening galas, and special occasions that call for refined style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises mesh.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
